Hey guys, hope yall had a nice weekend. Here's my update for week 15: https://hackmd.io/@aarishnaiyer/rJ81cpCFfx

I hit a blocker this week. So, producing actual chunks from a live BeaconState needs an internal Merkle value that milhouse doesn't expose publicly yet. confirmed the gap, found a related upstream PR, and I'm raising the fix with Michael Sproul. Also cleaned up CI on the bug fix PRs, got #9865 and #9903 marked ready for review, and verified #9666 can be cleanly rebased.
